title: An immutable time class
description:
Write an immutable `final class Time` for times of day, with static factories and constants:

```java
static final Time MIDNIGHT, NOON
static Time of(int hour, int minute)     // IllegalArgumentException outside 0-23 / 0-59
static Time parse(String text)           // "9:05" or "09:05"; anything else: IllegalArgumentException
Time plusMinutes(int minutes)            // a NEW time, wrapping around midnight; minutes may be negative
int minutesUntil(Time later)             // minutes going forward: 23:00 to 01:00 is 120
boolean isBefore(Time other)
String toString()                        // "09:05"
boolean equals(Object o), int hashCode() // equal when hour and minute are equal
```

- The constructor is private; the fields are `private final`.
- `parse` trims spaces; the hour has one or two digits and the minute exactly two.
hints: Work in minutes since midnight internally: `Math.floorMod(total + minutes, 1440)` handles wrapping in both directions.
rules: Make the constructor private and create times through the factory methods.
Keep the fields private and final.
